dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you two are getting along better nowadays...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Me? And that Tusheng? Hahaha! You sure are funny. Look, I'm just an old fellow giving him food, board, and a salary out of the goodness of my heart. And he's turned out quite good at toughing his job out.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: In short, it's a boss-employee relationship, alright? Just that.
